{{Quote|Layers and layers of construction have erased most topographical features from view, but the single jagged outcropping of this one mountain peak still protrudes from the surrounding buildings, to the amazement and delight of all.|[[Pollux Hax/Legends|Pollux Hax]]|<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
'''Monument Plaza''', also known as '''Monument Park''', was a large plaza on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The plaza circled the summit of [[Umate/Legends|Umate]], one of the highest peaks of the [[Manarai Mountains]]. Thousands of tourists came to the plaza each day to touch the giant lump of rock in the center; it was said that Monument Plaza was the only place on Coruscant where people could touch bare rock. The surrounding mall resembled a stadium with the peak of Umate standing in the center. Huge statues and colorful banners decorated the grounds, while restaurants and shops were built into the plaza walls. Amongst the popular sites in or near the plaza were the [[Manarai]] restaurant, the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]], and the old [[Senate Hall]].

Monument Plaza was the site of several events throughout its history, including a battle of the [[Great Droid Revolution]], a terrorist threat by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] movement, and a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] rally during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power it replaced the statues of the plaza with those honoring Imperial heroes. Monument Plaza was damaged sometime before [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], when it and the peak of Umate were turned into a [[yorik coral]]-covered crater. After the war, the [[Reconstruction Authority]] restored the plaza to its original state, rebuilding much of what was damaged.

==Description==
[[File:MonumentPlazaStatue-FF9.png|thumb|left|150px|One of Monument Plaza's many statues during the Galactic Republic]]
Monument Plaza was a bowl-shaped arena in the Manarai Mountains, and the only place on Coruscant where one could touch the bare rock of the planet&mdash;namely the peak of Umate, one of the highest peaks in the Manarai.<ref name="CCW" /> It sat one kilometer south of the site of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]],<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 9|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 9]] establishes Monument Plaza as "just outside" the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]], which ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' states is one kilometer south of the palace.</ref> and was visible from that building.<ref name="ISWU" />

Monument Plaza resembled a sports arena, with towering buildings forming its perimeter and an open space occupying the area inside. The bare peak of Umate sat in the center of the plaza, protruding from a hole in its floor.<ref name="ISWU" /> It was forbidden to chip away pieces of Umate's rock. Surrounding the plaza were a number of restaurants and souvenir shops,<ref name="CCW" /> including the prestigious [[Manarai]] restaurant.<ref name="SOTESB" /> The Galactic Museum lay next to it as well, and the original [[Senate Hall]] was nearby.<ref name="FF" /> The buildings of Monument Plaza were in the style of the [[Hasennan period]], characterized by an epic style of architecture.<ref name="CCW" /> The [[North Garden]] was one of the sections of the plaza, capable of holding over 6,000 individuals.<ref name="HNN2">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref>

A cavalcade of memorials and banners of various cultures and species lined the approach to Monument Plaza,<ref name="ISWU" /> and a set of main gates provided entrance to it.<ref name="sound">[[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]] liner notes</ref> Statues commemorating heroes and colorful banners lined the plaza,<ref name="CCW" /> giving the plaza its name,<ref name="Invincible" /> and the overall atmosphere was bright and airy. In the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the plaza statuary consisted of heroes and key figures from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in a celebration of galactic diversity. [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] often used the plaza to hold press conferences, supporting their image with the presence of these celebrated cultural figures.<ref name="FF" /> One of the last statues to be installed during the Republic was that of [[Phow Ji]], a mercenary who had fought for the Republic in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> Under the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the statues of the plaza were of Imperial dignitaries and the Empire's own heroes, and above them all, a gigantic statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="FF" /> Monument Plaza was overseen by a [[Plaza Director]], a position held by [[Shelbin Dang]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="HNN1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_5.html|Menarai Watch Follows Threat}}</ref>

Monument Plaza was a historic landmark, and the public concourse of the Manarai historical site.<ref name="HNN2" /> It was a popular recreational area, with many of the planet's inhabitants and civil servants visiting.<ref name="ISWU" /> Admission to the plaza was free, and it was continuously open. Monument Plaza was one of Coruscant's most popular tourist attractions, with thousands of visitors every day viewing the peak in curious disbelief at the thought that it was the only spot they could touch the planet's bare surface.<ref name="CCW" /> It was also a popular starting point for tours of the city.<ref name="FF" /> However, the plaza was also seen by some as the epitome of all that was wrong with the planet. They compared the display of bare rock to the caging of an animal in a zoo.<ref name="CCW" />

After the ravaging of the plaza in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], all that remained visible was an immense crater in the ruins of the Manarai Mountains. A ring of [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] remained along the shoulder of the crater, which was inhabited by winged creatures.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> The plaza itself was buried beneath two meters of [[yorik coral]], and Umate covered in stone-dissolving [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]], speculated to be a [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] device. However, with Monument Plaza's reconstruction, the thousands of statues that had once filled it were recreated identically. Others were added, in particular ''[[Devoted Technician]]'', a statue commemorating the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that had helped the [[Reconstruction Authority]] rebuild the galaxy after the war. [[Hologram/Legends|Holograms]] of individuals of various species were set up near the statues to give information on the monuments to visitors, some of it self-aggrandizing propaganda on the part of the Authority.<ref name="Invincible" />

With the rebuilding, the plaza once again became a popular site for tourists and office workers, though the heavy amount of tourist traffic left it strewn with litter. The post-war plaza square was made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], and where it dropped off into the chasms between buildings it was blocked by a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] safety wall. Sites around the plaza included the [[Traveler's Palace]] and [[Curat Commercial Center]], with traffic routes out including the [[Arakyd Towers ThroughPass]] and [[TravRat Gap]], which passed between the Palace and Commercial Center. A no-fly security zone was enacted over Monument Plaza, keeping the sky above it free of traffic, and plainclothes security agents were stationed around the plaza to keep watch for potential terrorist attacks.<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
In [[4015 BBY]], the [[Great Droid Revolution]] began, with [[Droid/Legends|droids]] rising in revolt and turning on Coruscant. Monument Plaza was the site of one of its battles; in a memorable battle above the plaza, the [[juggernaut war droid]]s of Coruscant's home guard destroyed a platoon of the Republic's [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|rocket-jumpers]].<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

The plaza remained a popular destination almost 4,000 years later, in the time of the late Republic. Approximately a month before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, an untraceable anonymous call was made warning that there would be a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terror attack on the plaza. The call warned that the attack would be carried out through a droid-delivered bomb. In response, [[Monument Plaza security|local security]] closed the plaza and evacuated its inhabitants, including the Flames of Umate followers, who responded by praying loudly in protest of their ejection from the site. Security also banned all droids from the area and increased armed security around the peak of Umate. Shelbin Dang, Plaza Director at the time, announced that the Plaza was planned to reopen within a week.<ref name="HNN1" />

[[File:70RepublicYouthSpeechFinal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nenevanth Tion gives a speech at Monument Plaza.]]

In fact, it would not open for a year and a half. With [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] standing guard over Umate, the Plaza's reopening was celebrated with a rally by the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic's]] [[SAGroup (COMPOR)/Legends|SAGroup]]. Over 6,000 members marched in military fashion from the [[Jrade-Daders Concourse]] to the plaza, carrying banners of loyal Republic worlds in celebration of recent Republic victories, while 10,000 citizens watched. Still others throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] watched on a live broadcast. At the plaza, the SAGroup members assembled in the North Garden, where brigade leader [[Nenevanth Tion]] recited an ancient speech of [[Uueg Tching]], Emperor of the [[Atrisi system]], on the removal of corruption. The youths then sang from [[Dha Werda Verda]], after which Supreme Chancellor Palpatine addressed the gathering via holocom.<ref name="HNN2" /> As one of his last acts as Supreme Chancellor, Palpatine had a statue of the mercenary Phow Ji installed.<ref name="JT" />

When the Empire came to power, the statues celebrating galactic heroes were torn down and replaced with statues of Imperial heroes and officials. A massive statue of Emperor Palpatine was erected in the plaza as well, looming over all the other sculptures.<ref name="FF" /> The displays along the approach to the plaza, however, remained as diverse as they ever were.<ref name="ISWU" /> The plaza's Manarai restaurant became a popular place for the Imperial upper-class,<ref name="SOTESB" /> and Palpatine often visited Monument Plaza when he sought solitude.<ref name="ISWU" /> When Palpatine died, the Monument Plaza was the site of a [[Coruscant uprising|riot]] by various Coruscanti people celebrating their freedom from the Empire<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}} Special Edition</ref> before it was put down by Ysanne Isard. In addition, in the long term, the Empire fell into chaos, as different factions sought to claim supremacy. During the [[Imperial Civil War]], elements of the Empire engaged in battle in Monument Plaza.<ref name="HB">[[Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 3: ''Dark Empire'']]</ref>

[[File:Monument_Plaza_Mutiny.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Imperial Civil War sweeps Monument Plaza.]]

Over the next decades, as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] retook Coruscant and eventually became involved in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Monument Plaza remained a fixture of the planet.<ref name="TUF" /> However, when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|invaded Coruscant]], they bombarded and [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the world, destroying many of the planet's structures and converting others into wildlife and plant-covered landscape.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> It is possible that Monument Plaza was used by the Vong to grow their organic war materiél.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] landed on Coruscant in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], they found a large crater in the plaza's place.<ref name="TUF" />

After the close of the Vong War, the Reconstruction Authority was formed, an organization dedicated to rebuilding the war-ravaged galaxy. As a finale to its project, the Authority spent years restoring Monument Plaza. It took three years to removed the layer of yorik coral that coated the plaza and five years to rebuild the statues with the original materials and methods. A year was also spent removing the stone-dissolving lichens from the peak of Umate. When the project was finished, the Authority pronounced it their crowning achievement and an incredible success in their mission to restore the galaxy to its pre-war state.<ref name="Invincible" />

By [[41 ABY]], the plaza was once again a popular tourist attraction. It was this and many other secrecy-aiding aspects of the site that made it a common place for [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] to meet his informants, as he did with fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. Skywalker, in opposition to the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Darth Caedus]], sought information on Caedus' whereabouts, and along with his aunt [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and cousin [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], rendezvoused with Shevu in the plaza. Shevu was followed by GAG personnel, though, including Caedus' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Tahiri Veila]], and they soon closed in on Shevu and Skywalker. Though Skywalker attempted to fight his way from the plaza, he was captured and transported from the plaza in a GAG [[Doomsled]]. The Solos hijacked a [[Medical speeder|medwagon]] and pursued, though they were ultimately unsuccessful in retrieving him.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Inhabitants==
The [[Flames of Umate]] were a religious sect local to the plaza area who had guarded the peak of Umate for generations.<ref name="CCW" /><ref name="HNN1" /> The Flames wore robes, and sought to communicate with the "world-spirit" that they believed resided in the molten core of Coruscant by meditating with their hands touching the rock.<ref name="CCW" /> They attempted to seek the peace that the planet had felt before it had become entirely urbanized.<ref name="ISWU" /> The Flames also kept vigil to prevent tourists from chipping rock off the mountain.<ref name="CCW" /> In 22 BBY, the Flames of Umate were ejected from the plaza due to the terrorist threat against it.<ref name="HNN1" /> Even in the time of the Empire, Palpatine tolerated the existence of the sect.<ref name="ISWU" />

In the time of the Empire, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]/[[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Anniha Nega]] used Monument Plaza as a contact point. Those who wished to hire him placed their request under a specific paving stone in the plaza, where he would pick it up.<ref name="CCW" />

==Locations==
===Manarai===
{{Main|Manarai}}
The Manarai was an upscale restaurant in Monument Plaza, and a popular spot for the Imperial elite. It was located in a spire alongside the plaza, and diners could view the plaza and cityscape below. The levels of the restaurant were, in fact, tiered to ensure an optimal view of both.<ref name="SOTESB" /> The most exclusive restaurant on Coruscant, the Manarai required reservations months in advance, and even then only from individuals on the approved list. One of its owners was the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who often dined there.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

===Galactic Museum===
{{Main|Galactic Museum/Legends}}
The Galactic Museum was the galaxy's chief repository for important artifacts. The Museum held billions of relics, with less than 1% on display.<ref name="CCW" /> The exhibits, like the plaza, celebrated the galaxy's diversity. When the Empire came to power, many wings of the Museum were transformed into a celebration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] or closed off, including the exhibits on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Jedi section also housed a secret tunnel to the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] and secret prison ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''.<ref name="FF" />

===Umate===
{{Main|Umate/Legends}}
Umate, also known as KnobHead,<ref name="Invincible" /> was one of the Manarai Mountains' highest peaks, though not ''the'' highest. Made of [[Granite/Legends|granite]],<ref name="CCW" /> the lump of rock protruded above the plaza about twenty meters,<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> casting its shadow over visitors. Removing rock from the peak was forbidden, and the Flames of Umate kept an eye out for this.<ref name="CCW" /> During the Yuuzhan Vong occupation of Coruscant, it was covered with stone-dissolving lichens.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Monument Plaza first appeared in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', where it was portrayed in a drawing by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] and extrapolated on in text by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. As some of the McQuarrie art used in this book was concept art from the ''[[Star Wars]]'' movies and other pieces were commissioned for the book, with whom the idea for Monument Plaza originated is unknown.<ref name="ISWU" /> It was called both "Monument Plaza" and "Monument Park" in this book, though the former would be the more lasting name.<ref name="NEGTD" /> However, with the publication of ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]], "Monument Park" was listed as a separate entry from "Monument Plaza," with "Monument Park" surrounding "Monument Plaza."

In the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'']] multimedia project, Monument Plaza was used again. For that project's [[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|soundtrack]], composer [[Joel McNeely]] created a piece representing Coruscant in the track "Imperial City." The piece is structured as an approach to Coruscant from space, followed by a journey through its buildings, as well as Monument Plaza. A welcoming fanfare signals the arrival at the gates of the plaza, which is followed by a reflective theme that plays during the trip through it.<ref name="sound" />
